about: The bundled reader's model files (docs/OCR-BUNDLED.md). Fetched at BUILD time by scripts/fetch-ocr-models.mjs, checked against sha256, cached in apps/desktop/.cache/ocr-models (git-ignored) and copied to out/helpers/bundled-ocr/models. Nothing is downloaded at runtime. PaddleOCR PP-OCRv5 (Apache-2.0), as converted to ONNX by RapidOCR (Apache-2.0), pinned to RapidOCR's model release v3.9.2.

models.what: PP-OCRv5 mobile text-line detector (DB), every script
PP-OCRv5 mobile English recogniser (CTC): Latin letters, digits, punctuation; the first reading of every line
PP-OCRv5 mobile multilingual recogniser (CTC): Japanese (kana, kanji), Chinese and English in one; a line's reading is taken from it when it found Japanese
